verdict.rationale: Adyen's own docs cover an agent-run checkout session under both ACP and UCP, returning a session with totals and fulfillment options. They also cover delegated payment credentials, where Adyen tokenizes shopper credentials and returns a session- and merchant-scoped token that the agent passes to the merchant. The final confirmed-order step is only implied, through 'payment authorization' orchestration and 'complete transactions', and no order confirmation response or status is explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an order-confirmation response or status returned to the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full end-to-end agent purchase.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can complete a purchase end-to-end — checkout session, delegated payment credential, confirmed order

citations.quote: Manage the full Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) checkout flow on behalf of Adyen merchants.
Adyen returns the created session with UCP envelope, totals, and fulfillment options.
Adyen stores the credential and returns an ACP token that your agent passes to the merchant. The merchant uses the token to process the payment with Adyen.
Adyen returns a UCP token that is associated with the specific checkout session and merchant identifier.
Adyen handles the communication with our merchants and the downstream complexity of orchestrating stock validation, tax calculation, shipping, and payment authorization.
shoppers can make complete transactions without leaving the interaction with your AI agent.
